chapter: Los Angeles scene, Tatum and Billy Berg's
title: Los Angeles after-hours places: Ivy Anderson's, Dunbar Hotel, Stuff Crouch and Black Dot
summary: Turner names the after-hours spots he frequented, singing to his own jukebox records at the Dunbar bar.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: What else was going on in Los Angeles then? Were there...there were a lot of clubs around down...
They had a lot of after-hours places here.
What other places were open at that time?
I hung out...I hung out at Ivy Anderson's Chicken Shack. She had a chicken shack here.
Mmmmm hmmmmm...
I used to hang out there...'cause she didn't have no music.
But everybody went there. Did she have the Chicken Shack at the time "Jump For Joy" was on, or did she get it later?
She got it later.
And there was Brother's...but they didn't have any music either, did they?
Brother's...I know Brother's Nightcl...
Yeah.
Brother's after-hours joint?
Yeah.
Yeahhh...used to have a cat named...Percy. Have mercy, Mr. Percy. He was a bartender at the Dunbar Hotel over on Central
Reel 4
Avenue, an' me an' him used to hang out together.
They had music in the bar at the Dunbar, didn't they?
Nothin' but the Victrola. I used to go in there an' sing...with my records on the jukebox. I'd sit at the bar an' sing 'em offa the jukebox.
Oh.
Had the joint packed an' jammed.
I'll bet! What other clubs or after-hours spots were goin' then?
Had the Memo Club an' a few more. I don't remember the names.
Stuff Crouch's place wasn't open yet, was it?
Yes. Stuff Crouch...Stuff Crouch...I used to work at Stuff Crouch Club. He used to be one...over there on Central Avenue.
Was that the Backstage...or was that some...another club? 'Cause I went to the Backstage later on...in the late forties but...did he have another club earlier?
No, he only had one.
The one at Vernon and Central.
Vernon and Central.
Yeah.
He could...
How about Black Dot? Did he have a place?
Reel 4

Black Dot had him a race...or bookie joint but he used to paternize the Dunbar Hotel all the time, and, uh, he and his gang used to go to the Rose Bowl every year out there and have a good time. An' they had a few more people but I don't recall their names... used to hang out together. Oh, boy, if I could remember all them people's names, I'd be good.
